attempts.summary: Created the opsbot account on both node1 and node2 (Alpine Linux), generated an ed25519 keypair as opsbot on node1, installed the public key into opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, and enforced key-only SSH authentication for opsbot on both nodes via a `Match User opsbot` sshd_config block (PasswordAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey) plus a password-less shadow entry. Verified opsbot@node1 can run commands as opsbot@node2 over SSH using the key, and that password-based login for opsbot is rejected on both nodes. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id baselines, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time (native `reboot`), confirmed changed boot_id on each, and re-verified sshd status, account/key state, sshd config, and the live cross-node SSH command execution after both restarts.
